results.say: how do I leave a scan, back to the picker
results.title: Back to the list of scans

steps.text: That’s in the Scanner widget. Open Widgets ▾.
Click Scanner to add it to your board.
Your board is full, so choose where it goes: the arrows move it, and the gold outline shows what makes room. Then click Place.
The list of scans is already showing: click one to open it.

results.say: show me how to show logos on volume surge
results.title: Logos on Volume Surge

steps.text: That’s in the Volume Surge widget. Open Widgets ▾.
Click Volume Surge to add it to your board.
Your board is full, so choose where it goes: the arrows move it, and the gold outline shows what makes room. Then click Place.
This gear opens the Volume Surge widget’s settings: Show logos puts the company logos beside the tickers.
